name: idle_lookaround
about: A neutral Troika human with allow_alert_lookaround idles by retail's chance roll, its random waits elapse and the selector runs again; nothing fails (15, 25). CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule 0x102af660 case 1 (conditions-and-states.md 'The idle branch, decided'): no discipline/scene, no follower, no patrol, use_interesting 0, then step 5: m_bAllowAlertLookaround (+0x6434) and RandomInt(0, 99) < min(30, (m_iEnemySightings + 2) x 5) = 10 -> SCHED_TROIKA_ALERT_LOOK_AROUND_NI 0x4f (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_alert_look_around_ni.sch: SET_ACTIVITY ACT_ALERT_FIDGET_LOOKAROUND, WAIT 3, WAIT_RANDOM 3, SET_ACTIVITY ACT_IDLE, WAIT_RANDOM 2), else 0x6b IDLE_DISPOSITION. Seed 4 makes the activation select's draw land under 10 (read off the run: seeds 1-3 and 5-12 except 9 drew the disposition). When the program's last task completes, NextScheduledTask 0x10280f40 raises SCHEDULE_DONE and the same think re-selects through the same idle case: the look-around again or the disposition. No condition, no state change, no TaskFail.
